pli-tv-bu-vb-np5:1.1.1: tena samayena buddho bhagavā rājagahe viharati veḷuvane kalandakanivāpe.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np5:1.1.2: tena kho pana samayena uppalavaṇṇā bhikkhunī sāvatthiyaṃ viharati.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np5:1.1.3: atha kho uppalavaṇṇā bhikkhunī pubbaṇhasamayaṃ nivāsetvā pattacīvaramādāya sāvatthiṃ piṇḍāya pāvisi.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np5:1.1.4: sāvatthiyaṃ piṇḍāya caritvā pacchābhattaṃ piṇḍapātappaṭikkantā yena andhavanaṃ tenupasaṅkami, upasaṅkamitvā divāvihārāya
pli-tv-bu-vb-np5:1.1.5: andhavanaṃ ajjhogāhetvā aññatarasmiṃ rukkhamūle divāvihāraṃ nisīdi.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np5:1.1.6: tena kho pana samayena corā katakammā gāviṃ vadhitvā maṃsaṃ gahetvā adhavanaṃ pavisiṃsu.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np5:1.1.7: addasā kho coragāmaṇiko uppalavaṇṇaṃ bhikkhuniṃ aññatarasmiṃ rukkhamūle divāvihāraṃ nisinnaṃ,
pli-tv-bu-vb-np5:1.1.9: sace me puttabhātukā passissanti viheṭhayissanti imaṃ bhikkhuninti
pli-tv-bu-vb-np5:1.1.11: atha kho so coragāmaṇiko maṃse pakke varamaṃsāni gahetvā paṇṇapuṭaṃ bandhitvā uppalavaṇṇāya bhikkhuniyā avidūre rukkhe ālaggetvā
pli-tv-bu-vb-np5:1.1.12: “yo passati samaṇo vā brāhmaṇo vā dinnaṃ yeva haratūti” vatvā pakkāmi.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np5:1.1.13: assosi kho uppalavaṇṇā bhikkhunī samādhimhā vuṭṭhahitvā tassa coragāmaṇikassa imaṃ vācaṃ bhāsamānassa.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np5:1.1.14: atha kho uppalavaṇṇā bhikkhunī taṃ maṃsaṃ gahetvā upassayaṃ agamāsi.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np5:1.1.15: atha kho uppalavaṇṇā bhikkhunī tassā rattiyā accayena taṃ maṃsaṃ sampādetvā uttarāsaṅge bhaṇḍikaṃ bandhitvā vehāsaṃ abbhuggantvā veḷuvane paccuṭṭhāsi.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np5:1.2.1: tena kho pana samayena bhagavā gāmaṃ piṇḍāya paviṭṭho hoti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np5:1.2.3: atha kho uppalavaṇṇā bhikkhunī yenāyasmā udāyī tenupasaṅkami. upasaṅkamitvā āyasmantaṃ udāyiṃ etadavoca:
pli-tv-bu-vb-np5:1.2.8: sace me tvaṃ antaravāsakaṃ dadeyyāsi, evaṃ ahampi santappito bhaveyyaṃ antaravāsakenā”ti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np5:1.2.9: “mayaṃ kho bhante mātugāmā nāma kicchalābhā, idañca me antimaṃ pañcamaṃ cīvaraṃ,
pli-tv-bu-vb-np5:1.2.11: “seyyathāpi bhagini puriso hatthiṃ datvā kacche sajjeyya,
pli-tv-bu-vb-np5:1.2.12: evameva kho tvaṃ bhagini bhagavato maṃsaṃ datvā mayi antaravāsake sajjasī”ti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np5:1.2.13: atha kho uppalavaṇṇā bhikkhunī āyasmatā udāyinā nippīḷiyamānā antaravāsakaṃ datvā upassayaṃ agamāsi.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np5:1.2.14: bhikkhuniyo uppalavaṇṇāya bhikkhuniyā pattacīvaraṃ paṭiggaṇhantiyo uppalavaṇṇaṃ bhikkhuniṃ etadavocuṃ:
pli-tv-bu-vb-np5:1.2.18: “kathaṃ hi nāma ayyo udāyī bhikkhuniyā cīvaraṃ paṭiggahessati kicchalābho mātugāmo”ti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np5:1.2.19: atha kho tā bhikkhuniyo bhikkhūnaṃ etamatthaṃ ārocesuṃ.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np5:1.2.20: ye te bhikkhū appicchā te ujjhāyanti khīyanti vipācenti:
pli-tv-bu-vb-np5:1.2.21: “kathaṃ hi nāma āyasmā udāyī bhikkhuniyā cīvaraṃ paṭiggahessatī”ti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np5:1.2.22: atha kho te bhikkhū bhagavato etamatthaṃ ārocesuṃ.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np5:1.2.23: “saccaṃ kira tvaṃ udāyī bhikkhuniyā cīvaraṃ paṭiggahesī”ti?
pli-tv-bu-vb-np5:1.2.27: “aññātako moghapurisa aññātikāya na jānāti patirūpaṃ vā appatirūpaṃ vā santaṃ vā. asantaṃ vā
pli-tv-bu-vb-np5:1.2.28: tattha nāma tvaṃ moghapurisa, aññātikāya bhikkhuniyā hatthato cīvaraṃ paṭiggahessi.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np5:1.2.30: evañca pana bhikkhave imaṃ sikkhāpadaṃ uddiseyyātha.”
pli-tv-bu-vb-np5:1.2.31.1: “yo pana bhikkhu aññātikāya bhikkhuniyā hatthato cīvaraṃ paṭiggaṇheyya, nissaggiyaṃ pācittiyanti.”
pli-tv-bu-vb-np5:1.2.32: evañcidaṃ bhagavatā bhikkhūnaṃ sikkhāpadaṃ paññattaṃ hoti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np5:2.1: [mūlapaññatti.] tena kho pana samayena bhikkhū kukkuccāyantā bhikkhunīnaṃ pārivattakacīvaraṃ na paṭiggaṇhanti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np5:2.3: “kathaṃ hi nāma ayyā amhākaṃ pārivaṭṭakacīvaraṃ nappaṭiggahessantī”ti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np5:2.4: assosuṃ kho bhikkhū tāsaṃ bhikkhunīnaṃ ujjhāyantīnaṃ khīyantīnaṃ vipācentīnaṃ.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np5:2.5: atha kho te bhikkhū bhagavato etamatthaṃ ārocesuṃ.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np5:2.6: atha kho bhagavā etasmiṃ nidāne etasmiṃ pakaraṇe dhammiṃ kathaṃ katvā bhikkhū āmantesi:
pli-tv-bu-vb-np5:2.7: “anujānāmi bhikkhave pañcannaṃ pārivaṭṭakaṃ paṭiggahetuṃ, bhikkhussa bhikkhuniyā sikkhamānāya sāmaṇerassa sāmaṇeriyā.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np5:2.8: anujānāmi bhikkhave imesaṃ pañcannaṃ pārivaṭṭakaṃ paṭiggahetuṃ.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np5:2.9: evañca pana bhikkhave imaṃ sikkhāpadaṃ uddiseyyātha:”
pli-tv-bu-vb-np5:2.10.1: “yo pana bhikkhu aññātikāya bhikkhuniyā hatthato cīvaraṃ paṭiggaṇheyya aññatra pārivaṭṭakā, nissaggiyaṃ pācittiyanti”.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np5:3.1.6: mātito vā pitito vā yāva sattamā pitāmahayugā asambaddhā.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np5:3.1.15: nissajjitabbaṃ saṅghassa vā gaṇassa vā puggalassa vā.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np5:3.1.18: idamme bhante cīvaraṃ aññātikāya bhikkhuniyā hatthato paṭiggahitaṃ aññatra pārivaṭṭakā nissaggiyaṃ,
pli-tv-bu-vb-np5:3.2.1: aññātikāya aññātikasaññī cīvaraṃ paṭiggaṇhāti aññatra pārivattakā, nissaggiyaṃ pācittiyaṃ.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np5:3.2.2: aññātikāya vematiko cīvaraṃ paṭiggaṇhāti aññatra pārivaṭṭakā, nissaggiyaṃ pācittiyaṃ.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np5:3.2.3: aññātikāya ñātikasaññī cīvaraṃ paṭiggaṇhāti aññatra pārivaṭṭakā, nissaggiyaṃ pācittiyaṃ.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np5:3.2.4: ekato upasampannāya hatthato cīvaraṃ paṭiggaṇhāti aññatra pārivaṭṭakā, āpatti dukkaṭassa.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np5:3.3.3: pārivaṭṭakaṃ, parittena vā vipulaṃ, vipulena vā parittaṃ,
